purpose: Record an independent visual source-image review of the official Bomachoge Borabu Form 34B final TOTAL row, read directly from the official IEBC portal PDF.

sample.review_context_note: Full official-page raster rendered at 250 DPI directly from the freshly downloaded, sha256-verified official IEBC Form 34B PDF (no third-party crop pipeline or CI artifact involved). The portal only served this PDF after a home-page + set-election (2022 General Election, election id 5) session handshake; a direct id-only request returned a generic HTTP 500 error page instead of the document, consistent with the portal now defaulting to serving 2022-2027 by-election forms. This constituency's declaration form scans two physical Form 34B pages onto a single PDF page; the TOTAL row and a separate explicit 'Voter Turn Out' summary box (registered voters 56,991; voters who turned out 36,348; turnout 63.77849%) both independently corroborate the same figures, cross-checked against each other before acceptance.

review.reviewed_by: Claude Sonnet 5 (Anthropic), acting as an independent Kenya Data Atlas contributor agent
review.independence_note: The official Form 34B PDF was downloaded fresh directly from forms.iebc.or.ke in this session, its sha256 was computed from the downloaded bytes, and the TOTAL row integers were read directly from the rendered page image. No OCR, machine-candidate pipeline, or prior extraction artifact was used or consulted before recording these values. Constituency identity (BOMACHOGE BORABU, code 263) was read from the page header/footer marker and cross-checked against the governed geography registry before this row was accepted.

same_row_valid_vote_reconciliation.method: Independent visual read of the four presidential candidate total cells on the same final TOTAL row.
